title: Trump calls for 200% semiconductor tariff; Taiwan says cap is 15%
snippet: The Office of the US Trade Representative (USTR) on November 25 US Eastern Time released its Section 301 investigation report on "structural overcapacity," recommending tariffs on 14 economies. Taiwan's Executive Yuan said on November 26 that Taiwanese semiconductor exporters face a maximum tariff of 15%, not the 200% tariff threatened by US President Donald Trump, because Taiwan has secured most-favored-nation treatment under a Taiwan-US investment cooperation memorandum of understanding.

title: Netherlands pushes back on US MATCH Act to protect ASML's China business
snippet: The Netherlands is resisting US pressure to tighten semiconductor export controls on China, with Foreign Minister Tom Berendsen saying on November 25 that the government is working to block Congress from passing the Multilateral Alignment of Technology Controls on Hardware (MATCH) Act. His comments during a visit to Beijing underscored the tension between US export-control policy and the commercial interests of the Dutch semiconductor industry, particularly ASML's China business.

title: Japan backs robot foundation models for manufacturing, construction, logistics

title: EU hybrid quotas expected to push European automakers closer to Taiwan suppliers
snippet: The EU's non-discriminatory quotas on imported hybrid vehicles, which take effect on December 1 for 200 days, will push European automakers that are localizing production to deepen cooperation with Taiwanese automotive electronics suppliers, with Delta Electronics and Taiwan's five major electronics manufacturers drawing the most attention, according to supply chain sources.

snippet: SoftBank aims to commercialize data centers that combine quantum computing with artificial intelligence (AI) by 2029, working with Japanese national research institute RIKEN and US quantum computing company Quantinuum as Japan seeks commercial returns from its quantum research.

title: Kaimei expects fourth-quarter revenue to slip from third-quarter peak as AI project delays weigh
snippet: Kaimei Electronic, a subsidiary of Yageo, expects its fourth-quarter 2026 revenue to fall from a third-quarter peak as delayed AI projects and earlier customer stockpiling soften orders, though it remains cautiously optimistic about its medium- to long-term prospects.

title: AI servers keep EVA Air's US-bound freighters full — 2027 hinges on post-election AI demand
snippet: EVA Air expects strong passenger and cargo markets in 2027, with AI supply-chain demand driving exports of servers and electronic components. President Clay Sun said he expects AI-related shipments to stay high next year. He also cautioned that AI demand faces uncertainty after the US election.

title: FarEasTone urges firms to tackle pain points before ROI, citing its own NT$1M AI start
snippet: Companies should stop agonizing over AI payback and start by solving business pain points, FarEasTone Telecommunications president Chee Ching said on November 25, describing how the telecom operator launched its AI transformation on a NT$1 million (US$30,378.15) budget.

title: Evalue plans eight more 640kW ultra-fast charging stations in Taiwan in 2027
snippet: Fortune Electric Value (Evalue) plans to add eight 640kW ultra-fast charging stations in Taiwan in 2027, following the launch of its first in Taoyuan this year, as part of a push to ease range anxiety among electric vehicle owners, CEO Yi-Sheng Hsu said.

title: EU caps hybrid vehicle imports from all countries for up to 200 days from December 1
snippet: The European Commission will cap hybrid vehicle imports from all countries for up to 200 days from December 1 under temporary safeguard measures, with China receiving the largest quota of 191,800 vehicles.

title: Hackers target Taiwan's semiconductor supply chain, fishing and food sectors
snippet: Nine hacker groups are running 18 active campaigns against Taiwan as AI speeds up attacks, Cyfirma says

title: China says it is willing to ease business visa requirements after reported delays for Indian firms
snippet: China has said it is willing to make visa arrangements easier for businesspeople from both countries, after months of reports that Indian executives struggled to obtain visas to travel to China.

title: Hiwin Mikrosystem's 3Q26 revenue jumps 77% as CPO test orders extend visibility to mid-2027
snippet: Taiwan-based precision motion-control maker Hiwin Mikrosystem posted third-quarter 2026 revenue of NT$1.218 billion (approx. US$37 million), up 77% year-over-year, as it moves into co-packaged optics (CPO) testing, silicon photonics (SiPh), advanced packaging, and front-end semiconductor processes.

title: Asia made a big AI bet on Nvidia. What happens now?
snippet: Asian stocks have been on a rollercoaster ride after Jensen Huang's shock return as Nvidia CEO.

title: After Nvidia, will AMD be a target as China’s ‘2nd-choice’ supplier for AI chips?
snippet: Short sellers have targeted Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) over alleged connections to Chinese firms blacklisted by Washington, erasing more than 10 per cent off its value in a matter of hours and fuelling speculation over whether it could be the next chip company in the crosshairs after Nvidia. AMD shares plunged more than 7 per cent in regular trading on Thursday and slid another 3.4 per cent after hours, following a report from US investment firm Hunterbrook Capital disclosing a short position.

title: Эгоистичный ген — 50 лет книге. Самый известный труд Ричарда Докинза
snippet: Как говорил мой тренер «время оставляет лучших». И вот спустя 50 лет. 50 лет! Пол века. Спустя всего ничего книга смутьяна, консерватора и новатора, мастера дискуссии и околофилософской беседы, ученого по форме мысли и по сути своей, Ричарда Докинза - «Эгоистичный ген» «стоит не шелохнется». Что же в ней такого интересного? Экстремальные версии дарвинизма Дарвинизм, сам по себе всегда актуален. Так что думать его никогда не ошибка. «Дайте мне то же самое, но новое» как говорил один из гейм дизай
